events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1st, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: Impact of MTV
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, forever changing the music landscape. Before streaming, before YouTube, there was one channel that dictated the hits.

events.title: Oasis 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and introduced us to a whole new era of rock and roll. What's your standout track from the album that started it all?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting nearly half a million concertgoers.

angles.name: Spirit of Woodstock
angles.copy: It's 57 years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York, for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the world lost a true icon. Elvis Presley's impact on music and culture is still felt across generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable images in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman continues to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod. Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket felt like magic?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007, a true British institution who first hit screens 64 years ago.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showed their incredible range.
